user_prompt: I need to simultaneously log incoming shipments from our suppliers while also tracking the modifications we're making to our product line and ensuring our field technicians can submit their equipment maintenance needs through a single integrated workflow.

steps.step_name: I need to log incoming shipments from our suppliers and track modifications to our product line in an integrated system.
I need to set up a workflow where field technicians can submit their equipment maintenance needs.

intent_resolver.reason: The request requires three distinct, simultaneous workflows (incoming shipment logging, product line modifications, and field technician maintenance requests) that no single skill covers end-to-end as an integrated process.

sub_queries: Log incoming shipments from our suppliers
Track modifications we're making to our product line
Enable field technicians to submit equipment maintenance needs through an integrated workflow
